apps.versionDescription: Spotify Core v0.60.10 (Modified by Ares) — Built on Spotify 9.1.90: Upgraded Premium engine to SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated (direct SPTCoreProductState/SPTAdsProductState force hooks, TrueShuffle, Artist Liked Songs row, CMP/upsell blockers, cohort ad-flag killer & persisted customize cache) with 'Premium: Lifetime' display and no Trial badge or expiration notice.
apps.localizedDescription: Spotify Core (Modified by Ares) built on Spotify 9.1.90: 20 custom app icons in Appearance -> App icon (iOS 16.1+ & iOS 26+), curated first-install defaults, Liquid Glass UI (iOS 26+) & Legacy UI (iOS 16.1+), built-in Spotify Premium Lifetime & ad-blocking, synced lyrics & Sing mode, offline downloads, Audio DSP, AutoMix, Live Activity, and Open in Spotify Core Safari extension.
